item.title: Overview of Ecclesiastes – Finding Meaning Without God
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. Ecclesiastes: Summary, Themes, and Why Life Feels Meaningless Without God # Summary: Ecclesiastes is a brutally honest exploration of life “under the sun” — life interpreted strictly through human eyes, without God at the center. Solomon tests every major human philosophy: pleasure, achievement, wisdom, work, wealth, religion, and self‑indulgence. Each one collapses under the weight of meaninglessness. The book exposes the emptiness of human reasoning and reveals the one conclusion that makes life coherent: Fear God and keep His commandments — this is the whole of man. Ecclesiastes plays a unique role in the broader [[bible-overview]], standing as the book that exposes the emptiness of life without God.
